baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction at words 2, 4, and 8 joins disputing, God's signs, and those who cover or deny.
baseline_models.mechanism: A publicly visible sign is met by entwined verbal rivalry, while kufr supplies the act of covering the truth disclosed by it. The exception therefore marks a closed adversarial use of speech rather than every act of inquiry.

activation_trace.role: Entwined contention supplies recursive verbal opposition and functions as the mode imposed on the signs.
The visible mark supplies publicly available evidence and functions as the object the dispute tries to redescribe.
Obscuring truth supplies the literal denial image and functions as the dispute's epistemic effect.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies disbelievers as the people who debate God's signs.
changed_reading.after: The verse diagnoses a mode of debate: recursive contest that covers what the sign makes visible, not inquiry as such.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The warning at words 10-13 links deception to their repeated turning through the lands.
baseline_models.mechanism: Movement among bounded places creates a bright, continuous appearance of capacity. Yet the same cluster holds deceptive glitter, an unknown outcome, reversal from one face to another, and final destination; visible range is therefore not stable proof.

activation_trace.role: A glitter that does not hold supplies the attractive surface and functions as the false evidentiary force of mobility.
Risk with an unknown end supplies unresolved futurity and blocks present movement from proving final security.
Turning a thing from face to face supplies repeated motion and embeds reversibility inside the impressive course.
Departure toward an outcome supplies the terminus and makes destination, not circulation, the decisive measure.
Bounded places of earth supply the visible territorial field and function as successive stages rather than a single secure possession.

changed_reading.before: Do not be impressed by their free movement among lands.
changed_reading.after: Do not read repeated geographic turns as a stable verdict: the shining course is uncertain and carries its own reversal and destination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dispute at word 2 and the lands at word 13 permit a shared image of throwing, hard ground, and adhesion to earth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch field of jadal makes contention resemble an attempt to cast an opponent onto hard ground. The distant ground branch of bilad then lets unrestricted territorial movement display an apparent refusal to be stopped or grounded.

activation_trace.role: Casting someone down supplies the agonistic motion and functions as the dispute's attempted takedown.
Hard ground supplies the imagined landing surface and gives the verbal contest a question of footing.
Adhesion to the earth supplies arrest on the ground and contrasts with the opponents' continuing range.

changed_reading.before: The dispute is a verbal disagreement followed by a warning about mobility.
changed_reading.after: The dispute also carries an exploratory wrestling image: it tries to ground truth while the disputers look territorially ungroundable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ayah 5 turns the baseline footing image into an explicit operation: contention uses what lacks truth and stability as its instrument in order to make stable truth slip from place. The twist attempts to transfer falsehood's instability onto truth.

activation_trace.role: The throwing-down image supplies the baseline takedown and functions as the spatial question resolved by the next ayah.
Entwined contention supplies the actual speech event and functions as the operation carrying the false material.
Departure from truth and stability supplies the instrument's quality and functions as deliberately unstable argumentative material.
A slipping foot and lost stability supply the stated target motion and function as the intended effect on truth.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what is attacked and functions as the footing that falsehood cannot itself possess.

structural_cues: In 40:5, the instrumental construction with falsehood and the purpose construction 'to make truth slip' explicitly connect means to aim.
The surrounding plot to seize the messenger and the answering divine seizure place verbal destabilization inside a wider takedown contest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contention, falsehood, slipping, truth, and a marked purpose relation; I infer that falsehood is twisted around the signs to export its own loss of footing onto truth. A live alternative is a non-material description of rhetorical refutation.

changed_reading.before: Dispute may resemble an attempted verbal takedown.
changed_reading.after: The attempted takedown is engineered: unstable falsehood is wrapped into contention specifically to make stable truth lose its footing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same kind of movement that can deceive in 40:4 becomes a commanded method in 40:21 and 40:82: move through earth, direct perception, and read the last state through surviving traces. Mobility is not the problem; stopping the reading at present range instead of following it to outcome is.

activation_trace.role: Movement toward a final outcome supplies the focus ayah's latent endpoint and functions as the measure the visible course omits.
Bounded earthly places supply the field of movement and become locations in a historical archive.
Going and flowing supply actual travel and function as the first step of the corrective reading procedure.
Directing sight or insight supplies attentive perception and converts travel into investigation.
The last state and outcome supply the temporal endpoint and replace present strength as the unit of judgment.
A remaining mark of what was supplies the archive and lets vanished power remain inspectable.
The repeated going supplies a second traversal and functions as confirmation of the same corrective method.
Directed perception again supplies the required interpretive act and prevents bare movement from becoming evidence.
The repeated last state supplies the retrospective verdict and closes the surah's test of visible power.
Remaining marks again supply apparently impressive evidence, but now function as witnesses to a completed reversal.

structural_cues: The near-identical travel-look-outcome sequences at 40:21 and 40:82 bracket the long central argument of the surah.
Both passages foreground predecessors' greater strength and traces, then deny that those advantages protected them or made their gains avail.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two repeated travel-to-perception-to-outcome sequences; I infer that they teach how to reread the deceptive roaming of 40:4 as a diachronic archive. A live alternative is that they are independent historical warnings rather than an intentional gloss on taqallub.

changed_reading.before: The opponents' movement through many lands should not be mistaken for security.
changed_reading.after: Movement must be completed by looking backward through the lands to traces and outcomes; roaming deceives only when its visible present is severed from its archived end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The believing man in 40:28 conceals his identity but does the opposite with evidence: he exposes the clear proofs, preserves both the liar and truthful hypotheses, and reasons about consequences. This supplies a believing counter-model to jadal and locates the corruption in closure against signs, not in forceful public reasoning itself.

activation_trace.role: Entwined adversarial speech supplies the condemned mode and functions as the contrast case for the believer's intervention.
The visible sign supplies evidence that must remain inspectable and functions as the boundary between inquiry and denial.
Concealment supplies the hidden faith-identity and functions strategically without concealing the proofs themselves.
Clarifying by speech or sign supplies disclosed evidence and functions as the public basis of the believer's argument.
The opposite of truth supplies one explicitly tested hypothesis and is left to bear its own consequence rather than being assumed.
Truthful speech supplies the live alternative hypothesis and forces the audience to admit exposure to the promised consequence.

structural_cues: The speaker is explicitly a believer who conceals faith, asks whether a man should be killed for saying 'my Lord is Allah,' and then opens an if-liar/if-truthful fork.
His speech continues through 40:44 as warning and invitation rather than seizure, and 40:45 reports his protection from their plot.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a believing speaker, clear proofs, and an explicit two-hypothesis argument; I infer that this is a permitted evidence-preserving counter-speech to the closed jadal of 40:4. A live alternative is to classify it as exhortation rather than disputation and therefore not as a direct exception test.

changed_reading.before: Only disbelievers engage in argumentative speech around the signs.
changed_reading.after: The condemned mode is not argument as such: believing speech can protect life and keep clear proofs and both truth-value branches visible, while jadal closes that evidentiary space.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated dispute formula is progressively internalized: a heart is stamped, pride is located in the chest as the source of action, its desired greatness remains unattained, and the disputers are themselves turned away. Their outward range can therefore be read as an exterior circuit generated by inward blockage rather than evidence of inward openness.

activation_trace.role: The heart as understanding and spirit supplies an interior center and functions as the hidden counterpart to outward turning.
The heart supplies the explicit inner site and functions as the place where the dispute's closed circuit is fixed.
Stamping and sealing supply fixed closure and prevent the repeated verbal turns from becoming receptive movement.
Entwined contention supplies the repeated behavior and links the inner diagnosis directly back to the focus construction.
The chest as the source from which actions issue supplies an interior origin and functions as the motor of the dispute.
Pride and self-magnification supply the motive and drive verbal motion toward a greatness it cannot reach.
Being turned from state to state supplies the passive counterpart to taqallub and makes the disputers objects of diversion.

structural_cues: 40:35 and 40:56 repeat disputing God's signs without received authority; the first ends at a sealed arrogant heart and the second locates only unattained pride in their chests.
40:69 repeats the disputers and immediately asks how they are being turned away, shifting them from apparent agents of motion to its objects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heart, seal, chest-source, pride, non-attainment, and passive diversion; I infer an inner blockage that generates an outward argumentative circuit. A live alternative keeps the heart and geographic taqallub as independent moral and spatial images.

changed_reading.before: Their outward movement may eventually reverse.
changed_reading.after: Their visible turning is already the exterior of an inwardly constrained circuit: pride issues from the chest, the heart closes, and the apparent movers are themselves being turned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah identifies the shine that makes range deceptive: evil action is made beautiful, territorial presence becomes ground for exultation without right, and possessed knowledge becomes an occasion for self-satisfied joy when clear proofs arrive. The glitter is a self-validating surface that blocks the path and treats current possession as its own proof.

activation_trace.role: Deceptive glitter supplies the focus warning's surface effect and functions as the category filled by later scenes.
Prestige and apparent excellence supply social shine and let territorial and intellectual status look self-authenticating.
Making a thing appear beautiful supplies manufactured attractiveness and functions as the polish placed on Pharaoh's failed project.
Exultant joy supplies the affect of unjust earthly success and makes possession feel like vindication.
Joy exceeding its measure supplies overflow and functions as the bodily display of deceptive confidence.
Disclosure to a knower supplies genuinely knowledge-shaped material, but possessed as status it functions as a closed rival to the clear proofs.
Exultant joy supplies the response to owned knowledge and reveals the affective seal on self-validation.

structural_cues: In 40:37, the beautification of Pharaoh's action is immediately paired with being barred from the path and the ruin of his plot.
40:75 names rejoicing in the earth without right; 40:83 closes the historical survey with peoples rejoicing in their own knowledge when clear proofs reached them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beautification, blocked path, unjust earthly exultation, and joy in possessed knowledge; I infer that these specify the otherwise open content of ghurur in 40:4. A live alternative treats them as separate arrogance scenes rather than one optics of misleading success.

changed_reading.before: Geographic freedom is visually impressive but unreliable.
changed_reading.after: The deception is a whole self-validating optics: polished projects, earthly exultation, prestige, and possessed knowledge make present success seem able to certify itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The apparently free movers also plot to seize, but the action reverses onto them: they are seized, their plotted harm surrounds them, linked restraints replace free range, they are dragged, and all are returned. Taqallub becomes a temporary active phase inside a larger transfer of agency.

activation_trace.role: Turning from face to face supplies reversible motion and functions as the focus hinge between agency and counter-agency.
Departure toward a final return supplies the directional end that governs the temporary roaming.
Capture and confinement supply both the nations' planned seizure and God's answering seizure, enacting subject-object reversal within one root.
Capture supplies the end of predecessors with greater force and traces and functions as a historical repetition of reversed agency.
Harm descending and surrounding supplies enclosure and turns the plot back around Pharaoh's people.
A collar that binds the limb supplies bodily restriction and replaces territorial latitude with constrained motion.
Connected links supply a continuous counter-chain and function as the imposed sequence governing their movement.
Dragging and extending supply passive transport and make the former movers into moved objects.
Return to what one came from supplies the terminal direction and functions as the closure over every temporary course.

structural_cues: 40:5 reverses the planned seizure of messengers into seizure of the plotting nations; 40:21 repeats seizure after the command to inspect earlier power.
40:45 makes plotted harm surround Pharaoh's people, 40:71 changes movement into passive dragging in restraints, and 40:77 states the final return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated capture, enclosure, restraint, dragging, and return; I infer a deliberate transfer from self-directed roaming to imposed motion. A live alternative reads these as separate punitive scenes without making them a kinetic reversal of 40:4.

changed_reading.before: Their roaming is temporary and may end in reversal.
changed_reading.after: Their apparent command of movement is itself reversible: plotters who seize become the seized, free movers become dragged objects, and every route is enclosed by return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because waiting is a distant branch of the sign root, not the ordinary lexical sense of ayah. It remains anchored because the focus joins signs to a warning against premature judgment, while 40:55, 40:77, and 40:78 pair patience, a timed promise, permission for a sign, and arrival of the decisive command. Downstream prose should present it only as a temporal branch activation, not as a replacement translation of ayat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sign at word 4 and the command not to be deceived by the opponents' current course at words 10-13 leave open an interval between visible mark and completed verdict.

activation_trace.role: Delay and waiting supply a form-distant temporal interval and function as a brake on treating present success as final interpretation.
A visible mark supplies what is already disclosed and functions as evidence whose full outcome need not yet be present.
Holding the self from impatience supplies the reader posture and preserves the interval before fulfillment.
A promise fixed to a time or place supplies deferred fulfillment and prevents delay from counting as failure.
The repeated holding of the self supplies a second temporal guard near the surah's end.
The repeated timed promise supplies both fulfillment shown now and fulfillment beyond the reader's present horizon.
The visible sign recurs as messenger-borne evidence and functions under a stated condition rather than human scheduling.
Permission supplies control over when a sign appears and prevents opponents' current range from setting the timetable.
Arrival supplies the eventual transition from interval to event and functions as the point when the deferred verdict becomes manifest.

changed_reading.before: The signs are visible proofs being disputed while opponents presently prosper.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a sign is a visible mark with a possible waiting interval: present roaming can deceive by collapsing delayed disclosure into a verdict of failure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the fortified-building branch of jadal is remote from the ordinary sense of disputation. It remains visibly anchored when Pharaoh literally orders a high structure assembled so he can reach connecting means, inspect Moses' God on his own terms, and reaffirm the liar verdict after the project is beautified. Downstream prose should call this an architectural analogy for argumentative method, never claim that yujadilu lexically means building a tower.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The dispute at word 2 can activate the fortified-building branch, while the deception warning at word 10 supplies the risk of mistaking a constructed apparatus for access to truth.

activation_trace.role: A fortified, well-made building supplies the remote architectural image and functions as a model of self-enclosed argument.
Deceptive polish supplies the epistemic danger and lets a constructed verification device appear self-validating.
Joining parts into a building supplies fabrication and functions as the assembly of Pharaoh's imposed test.
A high structure supplies the literal tower and gives the argumentative architecture a concrete scene.
Reaching a limit supplies the announced verification goal and makes truth answer to a ruler-designed route.
A rope or connection supplies the means imagined to link levels and functions as the tower's epistemic ladder.
The repeated connection supplies the projected route into the heavens and extends the self-made criterion.
Overlooking and uncovering a matter supply the claimed act of inspection and function as Pharaoh's demanded proof procedure.
Making the project appear good supplies its polish and functions as the deception that hides its blocked and ruined course.

changed_reading.before: Disbelievers verbally contest the signs and are deceived by visible success.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, dispute can harden into a fortified verification apparatus: it builds the only route it will accept, mistakes construction for access, and uses the failed test to preserve denial.

strongest_changes: Ayah 40:5 resolves the possible wrestling image of jadal into an explicit attempt to make stable truth lose footing by means of unstable falsehood.
The matching travel-look-outcome frames at 40:21 and 40:82 convert deceptive roaming into a disciplined reading of lands as archives of reversal.
The believing man's evidence-preserving speech in 40:28 narrows the target from all argument to a closed mode that conceals signs and refuses live alternatives.
The motion arc reverses agency: those who range and plan seizure become seized, enclosed, restrained, dragged, and returned.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetition did not merely add examples; it supplied kinetic and epistemic transformations of the focus ayah. Verbal twisting became loss of footing, geographic motion became historical method, outward circulation exposed an inner pride circuit, and apparent control of movement inverted into imposed return. The Pharaoh tower also activated an unusual but traceable architecture-of-argument reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The ground-and-wrestling mechanism is strongly activated by 40:5, but its baseline link through the distant ground branch of bilad remains exploratory.
The inner-circuit reading may be a designed echo between taqallub, heart, chest, and passive diversion, or merely a productive cross-domain alignment.
The waiting branch of ayah and the fortified-building branch of jadal should remain temporal and architectural overlays, not lexical replacements.
